cues: Now the most important mechanism in this unit.
Heat ethanol with concentrated sulphuric acid at one hundred and seventy degrees.
Step one: a lone pair on the oxygen grabs a hydrogen ion from the acid.
The curved arrow shows that pair of electrons moving.
The O H becomes O H two plus, protonated.
